steps: I: some boxes are cartons, some cartons are utensils; a box may or may not be a utensil, so 'no box is utensil' need not hold (B, C fail).
II: cartons are papers and some cartons are utensils so some papers are utensils (follows).
check_code:
import itertools
# universe: types of elements as (box,carton,paper,utensil) flags
types=[t for t in itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4) if not (t[1] and not t[2])]
ok1=ok2=None
res=[]
for r in range(1,len(types)+1):
    for m in itertools.combinations(types,r):
        if not any(t[0] and t[1] for t in m): continue
        if not any(t[1] and t[3] for t in m): continue
        c1=not any(t[0] and t[3] for t in m)
        c2=any(t[2] and t[3] for t in m)
        res.append((c1,c2))
f1=all(a for a,b in res); f2=all(b for a,b in res)
ans={(False,True):"A",(True,False):"B",(True,True):"C",(False,False):"D"}[(f1,f2)]
assert ans=="A"
assert ans!="B" and ans!="C" and ans!="D"

steps: BELL->MKFA: reverse code AFKM; letters shift -1,+1,-1,+1 (B->A,E->F,L->K,L->M).
BOND->EMPA reversed APME fits same rule.
B, C, D fail the rule.

def enc(w):
    s=[-1,1,-1,1]
    return "".join(chr((ord(c)-65+d)%26+65) for c,d in zip(w,s))[::-1]
assert enc("BELL")=="MKFA" and enc("BOND")=="EMPA"
opts={"A":"XDMA","B":"XMDA","C":"XMAD","D":"XDAM"}
m=[k for k,v in opts.items() if v==enc("BLEW")]
assert m==["A"]
assert opts["A"]=="XDMA" and enc("BLEW")!=opts["B"] and enc("BLEW")!=opts["C"] and enc("BLEW")!=opts["D"]

opts={"A":31,"B":33,"C":28,"D":30}

assert m==["B"]
assert opts["B"]==33 and opts["A"]!=33 and opts["C"]!=33 and opts["D"]!=33
